newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lam Soon Food 1996 net loss HK$167.78 mln.
newsitem.headline: Lam Soon Food 1996 net loss HK$167.78 mln.

text.p: Company name Lam Soon Food Industries Ltd
NOTE - Lam Soon Food, a subsidiary of Lam Soon (Hong Kong) Ltd, is a food processing company.
Net is after an exceptional gain of HK$44.78 million on disposal of properties and loss of HK$17.89 million on relocation expenses.

The accounting policy for deferred expenditure, which in prior years was amortised over a period of three to 15 years, was changed during the year ended December 31, 1996. Such expenditure is now written off in the year in which it is incurred. It is considered that the new policy will give a better presentation of the results and the financial position of the group.

On the basis of the new accounting policy, the loss attributable to shareholders for 1995 has been increased by HK$47.63 million and the results for 1995 restated accordingly. The increase in loss attributable to shareholders for 1994 and earlier years amounting to HK$36.92 million has been charged against retained profits at the beginning of 1995.

The retrospective adoption of the new accounting policy also decreased the carrying value of the unconsolidated subsidiary referred to in the exceptional items. As a result, the full provision against the carrying value of the unconsolidated subsidiary has been decreased by HK$3.79 million.
The minority interests in the results for 1995 have been decreased by HK$1.81 million to take into account of their share in the above prior years adjustments.
Total dividend for year is nil vs two H.K. cents.
